strategies.outputReuse: Existing bounded exact-size pixel pool for ungoverned results; admitted results independently reserved before uncached allocation. Every output sample overwritten; no decoded-content cache.
strategies.paired: Materialize one equal-resolution plane of L bytes, release its4L coefficients, allocate result<=4L, then stream three16x8 batches plus one64B block (448B total stack). Old first-plane live peak retained as upper bound; total logical work and original transforms/colors unchanged.

decision: Output reuse substantially reduces allocations but is neutral in elapsed time; park it. Paired materialization further reduces allocation but regresses elapsed time; reject it. Restore qualified production and retain independent public ownership/peak/refusal/cancellation tests. No long repeat/full/package run for rejected code.
